what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Türkiye, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6610 Iranian refugees in Türkiye, 4.2% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1979 to 2025, and over Kurdistan territory in periods from 1979 to 2018.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1983 at 790 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 8731, at the end of 2018.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2018 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Türkiye.
These are year-end totals for Türkiye only, reported to UNHCR.
